claim: AADAPT supplies digital-asset adversary tactics and techniques.
OWASP SCS provides smart-contract requirements, weaknesses and testing guidance.
EEA EthTrust v3 provides Solidity review requirements and levels.
NIST SP 800-115 supplies a generic assessment process.
Automated smart-contract tools show incomplete and inconsistent detection, requiring expert validation.
Digital-asset assessments require economic and composability analysis.
Cross-chain systems require multi-domain semantic and monitoring analysis.
The public-source review did not identify one framework spanning all CSPTF layers.
